messages:
deploybot: [releasebot] NOTICE: Release window starting 2026-03-21T18:00Z is being HELD due to an active ingress latency anomaly impacting canary traffic. Auto-hold reason: control-plane API latency spike > 800ms for 3 consecutive minutes.

maria: saw it — canaries failing 5/10 with timeouts to upstream auth.

aj: confirm on our side, spikes started ~18:02Z right after the control-plane rollout step.

samir: ops, do we have a rollback candidate for the control-plane change? last known-good is v2.4.7-cp-stable.

katie: tagging release notes folks — we should pin the application rollout to 2026-03-22 09:00Z PT if we can’t clear within 2h. @maria thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: agree on a soft pin. prefer to attempt a quick fix-first: revert the control-plane flag toggle (feature_flag: new_ingress_mux = false) and rerun canaries. If revert fails, we pin and requeue.

ops_lead: initiating rollback candidate check. Samir, can you validate DB migrations won't be affected by the cp rollback?

samir: migrations are independent. cp change was only router-level. safe to revert.

oncall-bot: oncall rotation: emily is primary, pager duty notified.

aj: executing revert now: `kubectl -n control-plane set env deployment/cp-proxy NEW_INGRESS_MUX=false --record`

deploybot: [releasebot] ACTION: Revert command received. Starting canary re-run for release window 2026-03-21T18:05Z. Will post status in 8m.

maria: if canary passes, we resume this window and keep the same slot ordering. if marginal, we should still delay by 2 hours to monitor.

katie: ops, also please freeze any dependent schema migrations scheduled in the same release train. I'll update the release notes with the hold + revert reason.

ops_lead: confirmed: paused schema job queue and cancelled queued deploy slots for the next 2 hours.

oncall-bot: Canary results: step 1 OK, step 2 intermittent auth 504s.

aj: those 504s match the earlier spike. rolling back to v2.4.7-cp-stable now as precaution.

deploybot: [releasebot] NOTE: Release window HELD. Rollback in progress; pinned application rollout to hold until 2026-03-21T20:10Z UTC by @maria. Affected slots: 18:00Z-20:00Z.

maria: plan: 1) complete cp rollback 2) validate canary for 30m 3) if stable, resume remaining slots with a 15m dampening period for ingress. otherwise, reschedule to tomorrow 09:00 PT and notify customers.

samir: rollback complete, cp api latency back to baseline ~120ms.

oncall-bot: Canary validation: 30m window started 18:22Z. will report at 18:52Z.

katie: thanks team — I'll update the public changelog entry and slack release notes: short note about temporary hold and forced rollback, apologizing for noise.

aj: if we resume, can we keep canary size at 1% rather than 5% until EOD?

maria: yes, we'll shrink canary to 1% and re-coordinate if any degradation. thanks all. :thumbsup:

deploybot: [releasebot] THREAD CLOSED for now — hold active, slots rescheduled to 2026-03-21T20:10Z UTC pending further validation. If you need to reopen, react with :loud_sound: or use `/release resume <thread_ts>`.
